Mirabai Chanu wins historic gold at Commonwealth Games 2026

Indian weightlifter Mirabai Chanu secured a historic gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in the women's 48kg event. She completed a hat-trick of golds at the Games, rewriting record books with her performance. Other Indian athletes like Neeraj Chopra and Sreeshankar are also highlighted as medal hopes in track and field events, with India aiming for highs in these disciplines.
